problemStatement: Test how an MCP tool behaves under a reviewed deterministic fault, verify bounded recovery, and preserve executable regression evidence.

capabilities.summary: Run a credential-free local MCP failure, bounded retry, duplicate-effect check, and generated regression.
Dry-run and execute one allowlisted MCP tool against an exact approved plan digest.
Run bounded fault campaigns against sanitized traces or reviewed MCP targets and emit a versioned campaign result.
Convert supported failure evidence into a minimized replay fixture and executable Node.js regression.

supportedInputs.name: MCP Inspector configuration
supportedInputs.boundary: One reviewed server and one allowlisted tool; remote targets require explicit ownership confirmation.

supportedInputs.name: ResiliReplay campaign
supportedInputs.boundary: Schema version 1.0 with finite concurrency, retry, scenario, and total-time budgets.

supportedInputs.name: Sanitized trace
supportedInputs.boundary: Versioned ResiliReplay trace events; raw credentials and unrestricted tool bodies are not supported evidence.

generatedOutputs.name: MCP test evidence
generatedOutputs.boundary: Metadata and hashes replace tool arguments and result bodies before persistence.

generatedOutputs.name: Executable regression bundle
generatedOutputs.boundary: Generated only for supported causal failures and executed before a successful result is reported.

generatedOutputs.name: Campaign run
generatedOutputs.boundary: Versioned campaign-run.json with an integrity hash and explicit complete, invalid, cancelled, or incomplete status.

canonicalExamples.success: JSON result is PASS, recoveryAttempts is 1, duplicateEffects is 0, regressionExecuted and cleanupComplete are true.

evidenceTypes: SARIF, JUnit, HTML, JSON, and Markdown reports
knownLimitations: ResiliReplay is not a sandbox, security certification, or authorization layer.
Retry safety remains the caller's responsibility for stateful, side-effecting, or unknown tools.
The bundled demo proves a local deterministic fixture, not every MCP server, transport, or production environment.
Secondary agent-runtime support has different evidence levels; named integrations do not imply vendor endorsement.

relatedAebRepositories.relationship: Independent downstream CI verifies a released ResiliReplay GitHub Action.
GaugeMesh can invoke ResiliReplay across a process boundary; neither package is a runtime dependency of the other.

feedbackLocations.purpose: successful field test or adoption evidence
